parts.notes: The home page says only "the Creative Commons License" and points to Appendix 3 of each volume. Appendix 3 of volume I (DC) is the CC BY 4.0 summary, and its plain-language section says no one needs to ask permission or pay royalties; the tables of contents of volumes III (Semiconductors) and V (Reference) also point to "the Creative Commons CC BY license (Appendix 3)". Volume I's contributor log says the Design Science License was replaced with CC BY in November 2021, so the lead's Design Science License is out of date. The books include chapters and sections by outside contributors, first contributed under the Design Science License (a copyleft licence that also allows commercial use); whether each contributor agreed to the move to CC BY isn't stated.

notes: Checked against the author's own pages on ibiblio.org (re-read 2026-11-18: home page, volume I Appendices 1 to 3, the volume III and V tables of contents, and the ModEL page). Two works, both CC BY 4.0, which allows commercial use with credit; the books moved from the Design Science License to CC BY in November 2021. Caveats: outside contributors' sections were first contributed under the Design Science License, and their agreement to the change isn't stated (worst case that text is under the DSL, which is copyleft but allows commercial use); third-party figures or datasheet excerpts inside chapters weren't looked for; ibiblio.org's own site terms weren't read; the NGSPICE build hosted on the ModEL page is under its own modified BSD licence and isn't part of the grant. Edition dates run from 2006 to 2023. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
